WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY sf.transref, t.tradekind
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) as overall_avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.transref,
    s1.tradekind,
    s1.avg_optvolrt,
    s1.avg_optvolrt - s2.overall_avg_optvolrt as diff
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.overall_avg_optvolrt IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(diff) as avg_diff
  FROM step3
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    s3.transref,
    s3.tradekind,
    s3.avg_optvolrt,
    s3.diff,
    s3.diff - s4.avg_diff as diff_diff
  FROM step3 s3
  JOIN step4 s4 ON s3.tradekind = s4.tradekind
  WHERE s3.diff > s4.avg_diff
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(avg_optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt,
  AVG(diff) as avg_diff,
  AVG(diff_diff) as avg_diff_diff
FROM step5
GROUP BY tradekind
